verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents an official Grafana SDK or client library. What the evidence does show is adjacent: an OpenAPI spec (grafana-probe-3) is a building block from which a client could be generated, and the CLI (grafana-probe-5), the MCP server (grafana-probe-4) and the as-code configuration docs are separate capabilities. None of these counts as an official SDK, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
